integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically. The included program only checks algebraic identities and boundary inequalities as transcription safeguards. Literature comparisons are evidence against known coverage, not a proof of global novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an upper-bound refinement for positive shifts only. It does not prove optimality or existence at the bounds, does not improve the cases \(k=2\) or \(k=3\), and does not cover negative shifts.
title: Improved dimension bounds for multiplicative Hilbert cubes in positive shifted powers
